en.t: He also had two younger brothers.

units.source_text: 还领我去看后院的空地，说如果我们将来结合了，

en.t: He also took me to see the empty space behind the house, and said that if we were joined together in the future,

units.source_text: 可以在那儿盖间小屋，尽量织点自己喜欢的东西。”

en.t: we could build a little house there and weave as much as we liked of whatever we wanted.
